plan.notes: Requirements-only: the official catalog publishes a recommended-courses framework but no official semester-by-semester sequence for this transfer A.S. Recommended courses sit inside the published blocks: Gen Ed Core 32 + Additional Math/Science 6 + General Electives 22 = 60. The Mathematics core block is published as 3 credit hours but the recommended options are MAT 128 (5) or MAT 143 (4); recorded at minimum 4, so recorded components sum to 61 against the 60-hour graduation requirement. One course in Humanities, Fine Arts, or Social/Behavioral Sciences must be a Non-Western culture course. Transcribed from the Parkland College 2025-2026 College Catalog (catoid=3). Recorded total 61 = sum of transcribed course credits (catalog states 60; discrepancy documented).
